title: Split the Differences, Pool the Rest: Provably Efficient Multi-Objective Imitation
abstract: arXiv:2605.12000v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This work investigates multi-objective imitation learning: the problem of recovering policies that lie on the Pareto front given demonstrations from multiple Pareto-optimal experts in a Multi-Objective Markov Decision Process (MOMDP). Standard imitation approaches are ill-equipped for this regime, as naively aggregating conflicting expert trajectories can result in dominated policies. To address this, we introduce Multi-Output Augmented Behavioral Cloning (MA-BC), an algorithm that systematically partitions divergent expert data while pooling state-action pairs where no behavior conflict is observed. Theoretically, we prove that MA-BC converges to Pareto-optimal policies at a faster statistical rate than any learner that considers each expert dataset independently. translated_title: 分化差异，汇集其余：可证明高效的多目标模仿学习
translated_abstract: 本工作研究多目标模仿学习问题：即在多目标马尔可夫决策过程（MOMDP）中，给定多个帕累托最优专家的示范数据，恢复位于帕累托前沿上的策略。标准模仿学习方法并不适用于这一情形，因为简单聚合相互冲突的专家轨迹可能导致产生被支配的策略。为解决这一问题，我们提出了多输出增强行为克隆（MA-BC）算法，该算法系统性地划分存在分歧的专家数据，同时汇集未观察到行为冲突的状态-动作对。在理论方面，我们证明了MA-BC收敛到帕累托最优策略的统计速率快于任何独立考虑每个专家数据集的学习器。此外，我们为多目标模仿学习建立了一个新的下界，证明MA-BC具有极小极大最优性。最后，我们通过实验验证了该算法的有效性。
tldr: 提出多输出增强行为克隆（MA-BC）算法，通过划分冲突专家数据并汇集无冲突的状态-动作对，以更快的统计速率收敛到帕累托最优策略，并达到极小极大最优。
en_tdlr: We propose Multi-Output Augmented Behavioral Cloning (MA-BC), which systematically partitions conflicting expert data while pooling non-conflicting state-action pairs, provably converging to Pareto-optimal policies at a faster statistical rate and achieving minimax optimality.
